sentence_stem: Although the proposal was reported to have been rejected by the board,
correct_completion: it was quietly revived by the committee the following year.
full_sentence: Although the proposal was reported to have been rejected by the board, it was quietly revived by the committee the following year.
acceptable_variants: it nevertheless returned to the agenda the following year.
it was still quietly reconsidered later that year.

options.text: so the committee abandoned the idea entirely.
options.why_wrong: 'So' signals a result, but 'although' requires a contrasting outcome. The clause must go against the expectation set by the first part.

options.text: it is widely believed that the vote was fair.
options.why_wrong: This adds a claim about fairness, but it does not show the contrast with the rejection that 'although' expects.

options.text: it was quietly revived by the committee the following year.
because the board had met on Monday.
options.why_wrong: 'Because' introduces a cause, which conflicts with the concessive meaning of 'although'. The clause must express contrast, not reason.

grammar_focus: Concessive clauses with 'although' and reporting structures ('was reported to have been')
explanation: After 'although', the second clause must contrast with the first. Here the rejection is followed by a surprising revival, so the contrast is clear. The structure 'was reported to have been' presents information without the speaker confirming it.
translation: Хоча повідомлялося, що пропозицію відхилила рада директорів, комітет тихо повернув її до розгляду наступного року.
